_comment: GA4 nightly snapshot — read-only Data API pull by tools/ga4-snapshot.mjs. Windows end on 'yesterday' (GA4 finishes processing a day ~24h after it ends). Rates are percentages. Never a source of user-level data.

bots.rule: avg session < 2s over >= 10 sessions, OR 0 key events + avg < 10s over >= 30 sessions; 7d, by country

retentionSplit28.rule: surfaces = / · /indices · *-index · /watchlist · /bowman-bangers; guides = every other path; 28d unless noted
